blockingFindings.finding: RawVerifierResult exposes global evidence and native-artifact lists without a closed observation-to-artifact binding. The proposal cross-products all artifacts across all assigned obligations, allowing unrelated evidence to be claimed for an obligation.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Make obligation/evidence-kind/artifact attribution explicit in the verifier result contract and reject unbound or extra evidence.

blockingFindings.finding: NormalizedVerificationEvidence cannot explicitly bind each accepted item to the exact invocation or command, checkpoint/native bytes, observed result, and collection time or time-not-applicable disposition.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Strengthen the normalized evidence contract with closed invocation, checkpoint, observation, provenance, and time bindings.

blockingFindings.finding: Native artifacts are treated as proving evidence for every obligation rather than preserved separately as provenance for the raw verifier result.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Separate raw/native provenance attachments from obligation-specific proving evidence.
